note: Template for the --group-map input to prepare_magi_training_data.py. CLIP_A/CLIP_B are placeholders, not real clips: groups must come from real session/recording/passage metadata (same night, same session, same linked passage). Do NOT invent groups: a wrong group is worse than no group, because it hides leakage instead of preventing it. Without a group map, group defaults to one clip and the splits output records that limitation.
